core_obligations: Record the faithful flatness of the local ring map and use the descent lemma for Gorensteinness (proof lines 6514-6524).
Identify the fibre as kappa(x) otimes_k k' and conclude by the formal fibre result (proof lines 6524-6532).
difficulty_reason: For a locally Noetherian scheme X over a field k, a finitely generated field extension k'/k, points x in X and x' in X_{k'} over x, the lemma asserts that O_{X,x} is Gorenstein if and only if O_{X_{k'},x'} is; and that if X is locally of finite type over k the same holds for any field extension k'/k (statement lines 6479-6512). In both cases the ring map O_{X,x} -> O_{X_{k'},x'} is a faithfully flat local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings, so descent of Gorensteinness gives one direction by Dualizing Complexes, Lemma labelled dualizing-lemma-flat-under-gorenstein, and the same lemma is used to go up (proof lines 6514-6524). What remains is to show that the fibre O_{X_{k'},x'}/m_x O_{X_{k'},x'} = kappa(x) otimes_k k' is Gorenstein: in the first case k -> k' is finitely generated and in the second k -> kappa(x) is, and the claim follows because property (A) holds for Gorenstein by Dualizing Complexes, Lemma labelled dualizing-lemma-formal-fibres-gorenstein (proof lines 6524-6532). Reducing to faithfully flat descent together with a formal fibre computation is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
